title: Playable ad reports
content_data:
Playable ad reports are a type of report from which you can get data about playable creatives. > **Note**
  • Playable ads report returns data of playable creatives. `data_level` is not required in your request.
  • Running playable ad reports in CHUNK mode (`query_mode`= `CHUNK`) is not supported. You can only run synchronous basic reports in CHUNK mode. # Supported dimensions See [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1751617879104514) for supported dimensions of playable ad reports. # Supported metrics See [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1751617882108929) for supported metrics of playable ad reports. # Supported filters See [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1751617884206210) for supported filters of playable ad reports. # Lifetime supports Playable ad reports support lifetime metrics at the Advertiser, Campaign, Ad group, and Ad levels. Breakdown by time or location is not supported when querying for lifetime metrics, so when `query_lifetime` = `True` , `dimensions` cannot contain `stat_time_day`, `stat_time_hour`, or `country_code`. You can use lifetime metrics in synchronous playable ad reports only, because playable ad reports do not support the asynchronous mode. # Use Cases **1. Query data of the playable ads whose spend are between 0 and 100 in a certain period of time.** **Request Parameters：** ``` xcodeblock (code json JSON) { "advertiser_id": 666, "service_type": "AUCTION", "report_type": "PLAYABLE_MATERIAL", "dimensions": [ "playable_id" ], "metrics": [ "playable_id", "playable_name", "spend", "cpm", "impressions", "clicks", "ctr" ], "filtering": [ { "field_name": "spend", "filter_type": "RANGE", "filter_value": "[0,100]" } ], "start_date": "2020-10-10", "end_date": "2020-11-10", "page": 1, "page_size": 100 } (/code) ``` **2. Query data of each playable ads in different countries during a certain period of time.** **Request Parameters：** ``` xcodeblock (code json JSON) { "advertiser_id": 666, "service_type": "AUCTION", "report_type": "PLAYABLE_MATERIAL", "dimensions": [ "playable_id", "country_code" ], "metrics": [ "playable_id", "playable_name", "spend", "cpm", "impressions", "clicks", "ctr" ], "start_date": "2020-10-10", "end_date": "2020-11-10", "page": 1, "page_size": 100 } (/code) ```
